An engineering collective, first.

We're a small team of engineers, designers and architects building serious software for teams that need it to work: in production, at scale, on Monday morning.

We're neither a code factory nor a marketing agency with developers. We're engineers who take ownership: from diagnosis to architecture, from build to operation.

We work distributed by design, with a presence in Bogotá and Cali for projects that need on-site support. The rest of the time, we operate remotely with the same discipline.

We believe in software as a long-term asset: that's why we document decisions, control technical debt and build systems your team can maintain and evolve without depending on us forever.
